inputs.name: Sample options
inputs.description: Parameters relating to the sample(s) being analysed

input.name: Samples
input.description: The samples to process with this pipeline.

ncrna_fasta.name: ncRNA FASTA
ncrna_fasta.description: FASTA file to be mapped to before the genome file, typically containing ncRNA sequences.

ncrna_fasta_fai.name: ncRNA FASTA index
ncrna_fasta_fai.description: FASTA index file for the ncRNA sequences.

ncrna_chrom_sizes.name: ncRNA chromosome sizes
ncrna_chrom_sizes.description: A tabulated file of chromosome names and lengths.

fasta_fai.name: Genome FASTA index
fasta_fai.description: A genome FASTA file index generated by Samtools faidx.

ncrna_genome_index.name: ncRNA Bowtie index
ncrna_genome_index.description: A ncRNA index generated by Bowtie.

genome_index.name: Genome STAR index
genome_index.description: A genome index generated by STAR.

genome_chrom_sizes.name: Genome lengths
genome_chrom_sizes.description: A tabulated file of small RNA names and lengths.

representative_transcript.name: Representative transcript IDs
representative_transcript.description: A list of transcript IDs for a representative transcript for each gene in provided GTF annotation.

representative_transcript_fai.name: Representative transcript IDs and lengths
representative_transcript_fai.description: A tabulated file of transcript IDs and lengths for a representative transcript for each gene in provided GTF annotation.

representative_transcript_gtf.name: Representative transcript IDs
representative_transcript_gtf.description: A list of transcript IDs for a representative transcript for each gene in provided GTF annotation.

filtered_gtf.name: Filtered GTF
filtered_gtf.description: GTF filtered for 'basic' transcript tag and support levels TSL1 and TSL2 to improve performance of downstream tools.

seg_gtf.name: Segmented GTF
seg_gtf.description: GTF segmented for use in iCount peak calling using iCount segment command.

regions_gtf.name: Regions GTF
regions_gtf.description: GTF regions for use in PEKA using iCount segment command.

regions_filt_gtf.name: Filtered regions GTF
regions_filt_gtf.description: Filtered GTF regions for use in PEKA using iCount segment command.

regions_resolved_gtf.name: Filtered resolved regions GTF
regions_resolved_gtf.description: Filtered GTF regions using iCount segment command and then resolve unannotated regions by overlapping transcript segments.

skip_umi_extract.name: Skip extracting UMI to header?
skip_umi_extract.description: Skips UMI to header extraction based on the head format provided in UMI header format.

encode_eclip.name: ENCODE eCLIP?
encode_eclip.description: This is an option for data downloaded from the ENCODE resource, which moves the random barcode from the start of the read header to the end delimited by _rbc:

umitools_bc_pattern.name: UMI header format
umitools_bc_pattern.description: Format of the UMI header to extract.

source.name: Input Source
source.description: Input file type. Only fastq supported right now!!!

skip_umi_dedupe.name: Skip UMI Deduplication
skip_umi_dedupe.description: Skip the UMI deduplication of BAMs.

umitools_umi_separator.name: UMI Collapse seperator.
umitools_umi_separator.description: The delimiter that UMICollapse uses to search for UMIs in the aligned reads.

paraclu_min_value.name: Paraclu min value
paraclu_min_value.description: Omit clusters whose total data value is less than this minimum value.

inputs.name: Command Line Options
inputs.description: Provide customised command line options to specific processes

peka_params.name: PEKA parameters
peka_params.description: Parameters for PEKA K-mer enrichment analysis

trimgalore_params.name: Trim Galore! parameters
trimgalore_params.description: Parameters for Trim Galore! We recommend to include the default params along with any new ones you add: '--fastqc --length 10 -q 20'

run_te.name: Run TEtranscripts?
run_te.description: Run module which will quantify transposable elements in provided reads?

tetranscripts_gtf.name: TEtranscripts GTF file
tetranscripts_gtf.description: Requires an appropriate GTF annotation, for details see: https://www.mghlab.org/software/tetranscripts

ch_rpt_annotation_gtf.name: Telescope GTF file
ch_rpt_annotation_gtf.description: An extension of TETranscripts GTF file including also the repetitive ncRNAs: snRNA, snoRNA, 7SK, Y RNA

outputs.name: Raw genome crosslink bedgraph
outputs.description: Genomic crosslinks in bedgraph format for genome browser viewing.

outputs.name: Crosslink summary
outputs.description: Crosslinks summarised by gene, type (eg. CDS, intron) and subtype (eg. lncRNA, mRNA).

outputs.name: K-mer enrichment
outputs.description: K-mer enrichment motif analysis performed by PEKA. PDF file with graphs showing K-mer occurrence distributions around thresholded crosslink sites.

outputs.name: Quality control report
outputs.description: MultiQC report of important quality control metrics.

outputs.name: TEtranscripts count table
outputs.description: A count table summary of all genes and transposable elements mapped to by TEtranscripts
